outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of camera exposure timing with percentage overhead values; it contains no statistical significance symbols.
Panel B is a set of micrographs, not a plot, and contains no significance symbols.
Panel C is a set of micrographs, not a plot, and contains no significance symbols.
Asterisks marking significant differences at t=2 mins relative to the 0.0167 mW condition are defined in the caption as P<0.05, with the statistical test (two-tailed Student's t-test) also stated.
Panel E is a set of micrographs (with a heatmap row), not a plot, and contains no significance symbols.
Panel F is a scatter/fit plot of normalized area vs exposure time with no significance symbols present.
Panel G is a scatter/fit plot of normalized roundness vs exposure time with no significance symbols present.
Panel H is a scatter/fit plot of normalized length vs exposure time with no significance symbols present.
Panel I is a set of micrographs, not a plot, and contains no significance symbols.
Panel J shows photobleaching decay curves with no significance symbols present.
